# Data Policy — Linux-PERFORMANCE

## 🔐 Scope
Linux-PERFORMANCE does not collect, store or transmit any user data.

## 📁 Local Data
The only generated data are:
- logs (local only)
- temporary files (local only)

These files:
- are not uploaded
- are not shared
- are not versioned (ignored by .gitignore)

## 🛡 Sensitive Data
The project does not handle:
- personal data
- scientific datasets
- confidential information

## 🧽 Data Removal
All temporary files can be safely removed:
- logs/
- tmp/
- workdir/
- reports/

## 📜 Compliance
The project is compatible with:
- GDPR principles
- scientific data ethics
